_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to credentials.json (git-ignored) and fill in real values, then: chmod 600 credentials.json. Each top-level key is a LOCAL cluster name from es_clusters.json. Use an Elasticsearch API key: 'api_key' is the base64 'id:api_key' string sent as 'Authorization: ApiKey <...>'. setup/setup_security.py --create-api-key prints it in exactly this form. Basic auth ({"username": ..., "password": ...}) also works but an API key is preferred: it can be scoped to the collector role alone (CCS-9). For Phase-1 hardening, keep this same JSON shape as the value of an AWS Secrets Manager secret and switch credentials.provider to 'aws_secrets_manager' — no other change is needed.
